designDirection: Original ocean-themed mascot with shell-bun hair, coral tunic and lavender boots
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create an ORIGINAL ocean-themed tiny magical mascot called Ripple Ping for the MyStarQuest children's project. This is a newly designed character with its own identity.
Reference image 1 supplies ONLY the project's polished 3D rendering, oversized rounded head / tiny body proportions and charming glossy expressive eyes. Invent a different hairstyle, face palette, outfit, ornamentation and emblem. Do not copy its crown emblem, hearts, long pigtails or mirror.
Design: a huge softly rounded pale warm-peach face with two enormous glossy amber-gold eyes, rosy cheeks, tiny button nose and a cheerful smile. Seafoam-green hair sculpted into a short rounded wavy bob, with two compact spiral-shell-shaped side buns and a soft scalloped fringe. Small apricot seashell clips sit on the buns, each with a tiny pearlescent bead. No tall crest. Small rounded ears mostly hidden in hair.
Tiny upright body, two short arms and two separate little legs. Wear a coral-peach bubble-shaped tunic with scalloped hem over pale mint shorts, a small white embroidered spiral shell motif on the chest, and rounded lavender ankle boots. A short translucent sea-glass cape with softly wavy edges hangs behind the shoulders, like a flowing sheet of water. Simple pearl clasp at the neckline, not a neck ruff. One hand gently presents a floating transparent water orb with a miniature spiral of ripples inside; the other waves hello.
Keep a clear original silhouette: compact shell-bun hairstyle, coral tunic and lavender boots. No animal muzzle, fin-shaped ears, spiky head fin, pleated circular collar, dorsal ridges, fish tail, mermaid tail, royal crown or existing franchise insignia. No additional characters.
Style: beautiful polished 3D children's animated mascot, soft sculpted forms, premium toy-like finish, gentle studio lighting and subtle subsurface scattering, extremely cute and friendly. The head is about 60 percent of body height. Seafoam, peach-coral, warm ivory and lavender palette, with gold-amber eyes.
Composition: one complete character centered in a nearly frontal three-quarter pose, whole hair, cape, hands, water orb and both boots fully in frame, generous clear margins. True transparent background with no environment or floor. No text, logo, title, frame or watermark.
